description: Reach & Frequency INVENTORY ESTIMATE — how many people TikTok can reach, for what budget, at what frequency, over a fixed window, before anything is booked. THIS IS THE ONLY SANCTIONED SOURCE of the three numbers create_tiktok_ads_rf_ad_group needs (budget, purchasedImpression, purchasedReach), and that matters because TikTok does NOT refuse a reservation outside the range it estimated — it silently books its own maximum instead, so an invented number buys something nobody asked for. IMPRESSIONS AND REACH COME BACK IN THOUSANDS (110 means 110,000) and the create takes the same unit, so pass them back UNSCALED. Fix ONE of the three with rfPurchasedType (FIXED_BUDGET / FIXED_SHOW / FIXED_REACH) and TikTok predicts the other two; omit it to get the whole range. Reach & Frequency is ALLOWLIST-ONLY per ad account. Read-only, free, books nothing.

advertiserId.description: from list_tiktok_ads_accounts — omit only when exactly one is reachable

ageGroups.description: TikTok age band values; omit to reach all ages

feedType.description: STANDARD_FEED (large inventory, normal CPM) or TOP_FEED (limited inventory, higher CPM)

frequency.description: with frequencySchedule, the cap: frequency 2 + frequencySchedule 3 means "at most twice every 3 days". Must be <= frequencySchedule and never more than 4 per day.

frequencySchedule.description: the cycle in days, at most min(campaign length, 30)

gender.description: TikTok gender value; omit to reach everyone

languages.description: language codes from search_tiktok_ads_targeting(kind:"language"); omit for all

locationIds.description: REQUIRED, and from ONE country or region only — ids from search_tiktok_ads_targeting(kind:"location")

rfPurchasedType.description: FIXED_BUDGET | FIXED_SHOW | FIXED_REACH — which one you FIX. Pass its own number too (budget / purchasedImpression / purchasedReach). Omit entirely for the unconstrained range.

scheduleEndTime.description: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:59:59" UTC. On THIS endpoint the window may not exceed 30 days (the create allows 90).

scheduleStartTime.description: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:00:00" UTC. R&F is booked in whole days IN THE TARGET REGION’S time zone expressed as UTC, so an advertiser in UTC-5 starting Nov 3 passes "2020-11-03 05:00:00" — not midnight.

name: tiktok_ads_rf_inventory_estimate
title: Estimate TikTok Reach & Frequency inventory
